Handover notes, platform on-call rotation

The nightly batch window starts at 01:00 UTC and normally finishes by 03:30.
If it is still running at 05:00, page the data-platform lead rather than
waiting for the automatic timeout, which is set generously at eight hours.

Two jobs are worth knowing about. The ingest_orders job is the long pole and
accounts for most of the window; it is safe to rerun from the beginning after
a failure because it writes to a staging table and swaps at the end. The
reconcile_ledger job is not safe to rerun blindly, because it appends, so
check whether its partition already exists before retrying it.

Credentials live in the secret store, never in the repository. If a job fails
with an authentication error, the usual cause is a rotated credential that the
job configuration has not picked up yet.
